q: 昨天晚上我给朋友打___两个电话。
zh: 昨天晚上我给朋友打了两个电话。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ gěi péng you dǎ le liǎng ge diàn huà
en: Last night I made two phone calls to a friend.
why: One finished event with a counted object: 了 goes right after 打, before 两个. 过 would claim an experience at some point in life, which clashes with the specific time 昨天晚上.

q: 小王昨天下载___三个新游戏。
zh: 小王昨天下载了三个新游戏。
py: xiǎo wáng zuó tiān xià zǎi le sān ge xīn yóu xì
en: Xiao Wang downloaded three new games yesterday.
why: A single completed download of a counted number of games: 了 right after 下载. 过 means 'has ever downloaded' and 着 describes a continuing state, neither fits a specific day.

q: 我刚才给小李发___三条消息。
zh: 我刚才给小李发了三条消息。
py: wǒ gāng cái gěi xiǎo lǐ fā le sān tiáo xiāo xi
en: I just sent Xiao Li three messages.
why: 刚才 points to one finished act and 三条 counts the object, so 了 sits right after 发. 过 is experience over a lifetime and cannot go with 刚才.

q: 上个周末我和朋友看___两部电影。
zh: 上个周末我和朋友看了两部电影。
py: shàng ge zhōu mò wǒ hé péng you kàn le liǎng bù diàn yǐng
en: Last weekend my friend and I watched two films.
why: A bounded past event with a counted object takes 了 directly after 看. 着 is for a continuing posture or state, and 在 would make it an ongoing action, not a finished one.

q: 他昨天在手机上存___五百张照片。
zh: 他昨天在手机上存了五百张照片。
py: tā zuó tiān zài shǒu jī shàng cún le wǔ bǎi zhāng zhào piàn
en: Yesterday he saved five hundred photos on his phone.
why: One completed act (昨天) with a counted object needs 了 right after 存. 着 describes a state that lasts and cannot report a single yesterday event.

q: 为了买新手机，她攒___三个月的钱。
zh: 为了买新手机，她攒了三个月的钱。
py: wèi le mǎi xīn shǒu jī tā zǎn le sān ge yuè de qián
en: To buy a new phone, she saved money for three months.
why: A finished stretch of saving with a stated length takes 了 right after 攒, before 三个月. 在 would make the saving ongoing, while the English says it is done.

q: 昨天朋友请我吃饭，我们在饭馆里聊___整整三个小时，大家都不想走。
zh: 昨天朋友请我吃饭，我们在饭馆里聊了整整三个小时，大家都不想走。
py: zuó tiān péng you qǐng wǒ chī fàn wǒ men zài fàn guǎn lǐ liáo le zhěng zhěng sān ge xiǎo shí dà jiā dōu bù xiǎng zǒu
en: Yesterday a friend treated me to a meal, and we chatted in the restaurant for a full three hours; nobody wanted to leave.
why: A bounded stretch (整整三个小时) of one finished event: 了 right after 聊. 过 would mean a life experience, which does not fit the specific 昨天.

q: 他为了抢演唱会的票，在网上排___两个小时的队，最后还是没抢到。
zh: 他为了抢演唱会的票，在网上排了两个小时的队，最后还是没抢到。
py: tā wèi le qiǎng yǎn chàng huì de piào zài wǎng shàng pái le liǎng ge xiǎo shí de duì zuì hòu hái shi méi qiǎng dào
en: To get concert tickets he queued online for two hours and still failed in the end.
why: A completed wait with a stated length: 了 right after 排, before 两个小时. 着 and 的/地 cannot close off a finished stretch of time.

q: 我的手机没电___，你有充电器吗？
zh: 我的手机没电了，你有充电器吗？
py: wǒ de shǒu jī méi diàn le nǐ yǒu chōng diàn qì ma
en: My phone has run out of battery. Do you have a charger?
why: The phone is dead now and was not before, so the sentence ends in 了. 的 or 着 would not report the change.

q: 你看，下雨___，我们别去公园了。
zh: 你看，下雨了，我们别去公园了。
py: nǐ kàn xià yǔ le wǒ men bié qù gōng yuán le
en: Look, it's raining now. Let's not go to the park.
why: 下雨了 reports that rain has just started, a new situation, so 了 ends the clause. 下雨着 is not a Chinese pattern and 过 means it rained at some past time.

q: 已经十一点___，大家快回家吧。
zh: 已经十一点了，大家快回家吧。
py: yǐ jīng shí yī diǎn le dà jiā kuài huí jiā ba
en: It's already eleven o'clock. Everyone, go home now.
why: 已经 plus a clock time marks that the time has now arrived, so the sentence ends in 了. 的, 着 and 吗 do not report that change.

q: 我表弟今年十八岁___，终于可以考驾照了。
zh: 我表弟今年十八岁了，终于可以考驾照了。
py: wǒ biǎo dì jīn nián shí bā suì le zhōng yú kě yǐ kǎo jià zhào le
en: My cousin is eighteen now and can finally take the driving test.
why: 终于 signals that he has just reached an age that was not true before, so the age takes 了. 的, 着 and 过 cannot follow a number of years.

q: 以前他不会用微信，现在他也会用___。
zh: 以前他不会用微信，现在他也会用了。
py: yǐ qián tā bù huì yòng wēi xìn xiàn zài tā yě huì yòng le
en: He couldn't use WeChat before, but now he can too.
why: 以前 不会 versus 现在 会 is a change of ability, so 会 + verb ends in 了. 过 would mean he has used it before, the opposite of the contrast.

q: 网速变慢___，视频一直在转圈。
zh: 网速变慢了，视频一直在转圈。
py: wǎng sù biàn màn le shì pín yī zhí zài zhuàn quān
en: The internet has slowed down and the video keeps buffering.
why: 变慢 itself says something changed, so the clause closes with 了 to report the new state. 着 and 的 cannot report a change, and 过 would be a past experience.

q: 地铁快要到站___，你把手机收起来，准备下车吧。
zh: 地铁快要到站了，你把手机收起来，准备下车吧。
py: dì tiě kuài yào dào zhàn le nǐ bǎ shǒu jī shōu qǐ lái zhǔn bèi xià chē ba
en: The subway is about to reach the station. Put your phone away and get ready to get off.
why: 快要 … 了 is the frame for something about to happen, a change on its way, so 了 closes it. 着 and 的 cannot complete this frame.

q: 我们等___十分钟了，他还没来。
zh: 我们等了十分钟了，他还没来。
py: wǒ men děng le shí fēn zhōng le tā hái méi lái
en: We've been waiting ten minutes and he still hasn't come.
why: 还没来 shows the waiting is still going on, so the amount is marked by 了 after the verb and again at the end. 过 would make the waiting an old experience.

q: 我玩___两个小时手机了，该休息了。
zh: 我玩了两个小时手机了，该休息了。
py: wǒ wán le liǎng ge xiǎo shí shǒu jī le gāi xiū xi le
en: I've been on my phone for two hours; time to take a break.
why: The two hours so far are counted with 了 after 玩 and again at the end, because the phoning has lasted up to now. 过 would put it in the past with no link to now.

q: 他已经看___三个小时视频了，眼睛都红了。
zh: 他已经看了三个小时视频了，眼睛都红了。
py: tā yǐ jīng kàn le sān ge xiǎo shí shì pín le yǎn jīng dōu hóng le
en: He's been watching videos for three hours already; his eyes are red.
why: 已经 plus an amount so far takes 了 after the verb and 了 at the end. 着 cannot be followed by a duration, and 过 would not give the up-to-now amount.

q: 我用这个手机用___三年了，还没坏过。
zh: 我用这个手机用了三年了，还没坏过。
py: wǒ yòng zhè ge shǒu jī yòng le sān nián le hái méi huài guò
en: I've been using this phone for three years and it has never broken.
why: The three years run up to now, so the verb takes 了 and the sentence ends in 了. 过 after the repeated verb would not combine with a final 了 for 'so far'.

q: 这个群里的人已经聊___一个晚上了，消息多得我看不过来。
zh: 这个群里的人已经聊了一个晚上了，消息多得我看不过来。
py: zhè ge qún lǐ de rén yǐ jīng liáo le yī ge wǎn shang le xiāo xi duō de wǒ kàn bu guò lái
en: The people in this group chat have been chatting all evening already; there are so many messages I can't keep up.
why: The pile of messages shows the chatting has gone on up to now: 了 after 聊 and 了 at the end. 过 would describe something finished long ago.

q: 他在这家公司干___五年了，从来没请过假。
zh: 他在这家公司干了五年了，从来没请过假。
py: tā zài zhè jiā gōng sī gàn le wǔ nián le cóng lái méi qǐng guò jià
en: He's worked at this company for five years and has never taken a day off.
why: The five years run up to the present: 干了五年了 with two 了. 着 cannot take a duration, and 过 would suggest he no longer works there.

q: 你到___家就给我发消息。
zh: 你到了家就给我发消息。
py: nǐ dào le jiā jiù gěi wǒ fā xiāo xi
en: Message me as soon as you get home.
why: In 'once A is done, then B', 了 follows the first verb, here 到, even though this is about the future. 着 and 的 cannot mark A as completed.

q: 下___课，我们就去看电影。
zh: 下了课，我们就去看电影。
py: xià le kè wǒ men jiù qù kàn diàn yǐng
en: As soon as class is over, we'll go and watch a film.
why: The first step must be completed before 就 starts the second, so 了 follows 下. 着 would mean 'while class is going on', and 的/地 are not aspect markers.

q: 我洗___澡再给你回电话。
zh: 我洗了澡再给你回电话。
py: wǒ xǐ le zǎo zài gěi nǐ huí diàn huà
en: I'll call you back after I've showered.
why: With 再 the second step waits until the first is done, so 了 goes after 洗. 着 or 在 would mean the showering is going on while I call.

q: 昨天他吃___晚饭就出门见朋友了。
zh: 昨天他吃了晚饭就出门见朋友了。
py: zuó tiān tā chī le wǎn fàn jiù chū mén jiàn péng you le
en: Yesterday he went out to meet friends right after dinner.
why: In a past 'A then straight B' chain, 了 goes right after the first verb and a final 了 closes the sentence. 着 or 在 would make eating and leaving happen together.

q: 等我给手机充___电，再跟你一起去打球。
zh: 等我给手机充了电，再跟你一起去打球。
py: děng wǒ gěi shǒu jī chōng le diàn zài gēn nǐ yī qǐ qù dǎ qiú
en: Once I've charged my phone, I'll go play ball with you.
why: The charging has to be finished before 再 starts the next step, so 了 goes after 充 even though it is about the future. 着 or 在 would not mean 'once finished'.

q: 你看___我发的链接，就告诉我你的想法。
zh: 你看了我发的链接，就告诉我你的想法。
py: nǐ kàn le wǒ fā de liàn jiē jiù gào sù wǒ nǐ de xiǎng fǎ
en: As soon as you've looked at the link I sent, tell me what you think.
why: 'After A, then B': 了 goes after 看, before its object, and 就 starts the second step. 的 and 地 are not verb aspect markers, and 在 would make it ongoing.

q: 他下载___那个软件，就发现手机变得特别慢。
zh: 他下载了那个软件，就发现手机变得特别慢。
py: tā xià zǎi le nà ge ruǎn jiàn jiù fā xiàn shǒu jī biàn de tè bié màn
en: As soon as he downloaded that app, he found his phone had become very slow.
why: The discovery follows the completed download, so 了 goes right after 下载. 着 or 在 would make the download ongoing, which does not match 就发现.

q: 我每天晚上都用手机看___新闻。
zh: 我每天晚上都用手机看新闻。
py: wǒ měi tiān wǎn shang dōu yòng shǒu jī kàn xīn wén
en: Every night I read the news on my phone.
why: 每天晚上都 makes this a routine, not one finished event, so the verb takes no 了. 看了 would turn it into a single completed act.

q: 以前我们常常在群里聊___天。
zh: 以前我们常常在群里聊天。
py: yǐ qián wǒ men cháng cháng zài qún lǐ liáo tiān
en: We used to chat in the group chat a lot.
why: 常常 marks a repeated habit, even in the past, so no 了. The past comes from 以前, not from 了.

q: 去年夏天，他总是半夜才回___家。
zh: 去年夏天，他总是半夜才回家。
py: qù nián xià tiān tā zǒng shì bàn yè cái huí jiā
en: Last summer he always got home only after midnight.
why: 总是 shows a repeated pattern. A repeated pattern takes no 了 even in the past, and 才 does not combine with 了 here.

q: 以前我一般先看___朋友圈，再起床。
zh: 以前我一般先看朋友圈，再起床。
py: yǐ qián wǒ yī bān xiān kàn péng you quān zài qǐ chuáng
en: I used to look at Moments first and only then get up.
why: 一般 and 以前 describe a usual routine, so even though there is a 先 … 再 sequence there is no 了. The sequence rule is for one-time events.

q: 小时候，我哥哥每天放学回家都先玩___半个小时手机，再写作业。
zh: 小时候，我哥哥每天放学回家都先玩半个小时手机，再写作业。
py: xiǎo shí hou wǒ gē ge měi tiān fàng xué huí jiā dōu xiān wán bàn ge xiǎo shí shǒu jī zài xiě zuò yè
en: When we were little, my brother played on his phone for half an hour every day after school before doing homework.
why: Although 半个小时 is a stated length, 每天 makes it a daily habit and a habit takes no 了. Length of time alone does not call for 了.

q: 昨天我没接___他的电话。
zh: 昨天我没接他的电话。
py: zuó tiān wǒ méi jiē tā de diàn huà
en: I didn't answer his call yesterday.
why: 没 already says the action did not happen, so there is nothing to mark as completed. 没接了 is wrong.

q: 我还没回___小李的消息。
zh: 我还没回小李的消息。
py: wǒ hái méi huí xiǎo lǐ de xiāo xi
en: I haven't replied to Xiao Li's message yet.
why: 还没 means not yet done, which is the opposite of what 了 reports. 没 + verb never takes 了.

q: 上个周末我们没出去___，在家玩了一天游戏。
zh: 上个周末我们没出去，在家玩了一天游戏。
py: shàng ge zhōu mò wǒ men méi chū qù zài jiā wán le yī tiān yóu xì
en: Last weekend we didn't go out; we played games at home all day.
why: The first clause is a negated event, so 没出去 with no 了. The second clause is a finished, quantified event, so it keeps 了. Do not carry 了 into the 没 clause.

q: 他昨天晚上没给我发___任何消息。
zh: 他昨天晚上没给我发任何消息。
py: tā zuó tiān wǎn shang méi gěi wǒ fā rèn hé xiāo xi
en: He didn't send me any messages last night.
why: With 没, no 了 follows the verb 发. 没发了任何消息 is not Chinese, because 没 denies the whole event.

q: 虽然朋友一直约我，但我这周末没去___聚会，因为要加班。
zh: 虽然朋友一直约我，但我这周末没去聚会，因为要加班。
py: suī rán péng you yī zhí yuē wǒ dàn wǒ zhè zhōu mò méi qù jù huì yīn wèi yào jiā bān
en: Although my friend kept inviting me, I didn't go to the get-together this weekend because I had to work overtime.
why: 没去 is the negation of a completed event, so 了 is deleted even in a longer sentence. The reason clause does not change that.

q: 昨天网络坏了，所以我一整天没看___视频，也没打___游戏。
zh: 昨天网络坏了，所以我一整天没看视频，也没打游戏。
py: zuó tiān wǎng luò huài le suǒ yǐ wǒ yī zhěng tiān méi kàn shì pín yě méi dǎ yóu xì
en: The network was down yesterday, so all day I didn't watch videos or play games.
why: Both verbs are negated with 没, so neither takes 了. The 了 in 网络坏了 reports the change and is a different point.

q: 昨天的聚会很有意思___。
zh: 昨天的聚会很有意思。
py: zuó tiān de jù huì hěn yǒu yì si
en: Yesterday's party was fun.
why: A past description with 很 + adjective is a state, not an event, and 昨天 already shows it is past. Adding 了 would suggest the party has just turned interesting.

q: 他以前是___我的同学。
zh: 他以前是我的同学。
py: tā yǐ qián shì wǒ de tóng xué
en: He used to be my classmate.
why: 是 is never followed by 了 to mean 'was'; 以前 supplies the past. 是过 is also not used for this.

q: 我小时候很喜欢___玩电子游戏。
zh: 我小时候很喜欢玩电子游戏。
py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou hěn xǐ huan wán diàn zǐ yóu xì
en: I really liked playing video games when I was little.
why: 喜欢 is a feeling, not a completed act, so it takes no 了 in the past. 小时候 gives the time frame.

q: 我当时觉得___那个手机太贵，就没买。
zh: 我当时觉得那个手机太贵，就没买。
py: wǒ dāng shí jué de nà ge shǒu jī tài guì jiù méi mǎi
en: I thought that phone was too expensive at the time, so I didn't buy it.
why: 觉得 reports an opinion, a state of mind, and takes no 了 or 着. The past is shown by 当时.

q: 昨天的聚会上有___很多人，我只认识两个。
zh: 昨天的聚会上有很多人，我只认识两个。
py: zuó tiān de jù huì shàng yǒu hěn duō rén wǒ zhǐ rèn shi liǎng ge
en: There were a lot of people at yesterday's party, and I only knew two.
why: 有 describes how things were, so there is no 了 after it. 昨天 already places it in the past.

q: 当时我们都觉得___这个软件特别好用，没想到后来问题那么多。
zh: 当时我们都觉得这个软件特别好用，没想到后来问题那么多。
py: dāng shí wǒ men dōu jué de zhè ge ruǎn jiàn tè bié hǎo yòng méi xiǎng dào hòu lái wèn tí nà me duō
en: At the time we all thought this app was very easy to use, never expecting so many problems later.
why: 觉得 reports an opinion held at that time and takes no 了, even in a longer sentence. The past is shown by 当时.

q: 这个手机太贵___，我买不起。
zh: 这个手机太贵了，我买不起。
py: zhè ge shǒu jī tài guì le wǒ mǎi bu qǐ
en: This phone is too expensive; I can't afford it.
why: A remark that ends in 太 + adjective is closed with 了. 的, 吗 and 呢 make it either a different sentence or a question.

q: 你的新手机太好___！
zh: 你的新手机太好了！
py: nǐ de xīn shǒu jī tài hǎo le
en: Your new phone is so great!
why: 太 + adjective as a complete exclamation always ends in 了. Without it the remark sounds cut off.

q: 地铁上的人太多___，我们打车去吧。
zh: 地铁上的人太多了，我们打车去吧。
py: dì tiě shàng de rén tài duō le wǒ men dǎ chē qù ba
en: There are too many people on the subway; let's take a taxi.
why: 太多 is a complete remark about the crowd, so it ends in 了. 的 or 呢 would not give the 'too many' complaint.

q: 这个视频___好笑了，我看了三遍。
zh: 这个视频太好笑了，我看了三遍。
py: zhè ge shì pín tài hǎo xiào le wǒ kàn le sān biàn
en: This video is so funny; I've watched it three times.
why: The final 了 pairs only with 太: 太好笑了 is the 'so funny!' remark. 很 and 有点 do not take 了, and 不太 would contradict watching it three times.

q: 她发朋友圈发得太多___，我都不想点开看了。
zh: 她发朋友圈发得太多了，我都不想点开看了。
py: tā fā péng you quān fā de tài duō le wǒ dōu bù xiǎng diǎn kāi kàn le
en: She posts so much on Moments that I don't even want to open it any more.
why: 太多 is a complete complaint closing the first clause, so it takes 了. 的, 着 and 过 cannot end a 太 remark.

q: 我现在不玩这个游戏___。
zh: 我现在不玩这个游戏了。
py: wǒ xiàn zài bù wán zhè ge yóu xì le
en: I don't play this game any more.
why: 'Not any more' is 不 + verb + 了 with 了 at the end. Without 了 it would only be a plain 'I don't play'.

q: 下雨了，我们不出去玩___。
zh: 下雨了，我们不出去玩了。
py: xià yǔ le wǒ men bù chū qù wán le
en: It's raining, so we're not going out to play after all.
why: A plan changed because of the rain, so 不 … 了 at the end. 过 means a past experience and 着 or 的 cannot report a changed decision.

q: 我的手机里没有流量___，没法看视频。
zh: 我的手机里没有流量了，没法看视频。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī lǐ méi yǒu liú liàng le méi fǎ kàn shì pín
en: My phone has no data left, so I can't watch videos.
why: 没有 + noun + 了 means 'none left': the data has run out. 着, 的 and 过 cannot say that.

q: 她已经不在那个群里___，你别再给她发消息了。
zh: 她已经不在那个群里了，你别再给她发消息了。
py: tā yǐ jīng bù zài nà ge qún lǐ le nǐ bié zài gěi tā fā xiāo xi le
en: She's no longer in that group, so stop sending her messages.
why: 已经不 … 了 means 'no longer', so 了 closes the clause. 过 or 着 would not express a change in the situation.

q: 听说明天有大雨，我们就不去爬山___，改在家里聚会吧。
zh: 听说明天有大雨，我们就不去爬山了，改在家里聚会吧。
py: tīng shuō míng tiān yǒu dà yǔ wǒ men jiù bù qù pá shān le gǎi zài jiā lǐ jù huì ba
en: I hear it will rain heavily tomorrow, so let's not go hiking after all and have the get-together at home instead.
why: The plan changes because of the forecast, so 不去 … 了. 着, 的 and 过 do not express a cancelled plan.

zh: 我看了消息就给你打电话。
py: wǒ kàn le xiāo xi jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
en: As soon as I've read the message, I'll call you.
why: 了 goes right after the first verb 看, before its object, and 就 links the second step. 看消息了就给你打电话 is not how the chain is built.

zh: 他昨天给我发了三张照片。
py: tā zuó tiān gěi wǒ fā le sān zhāng zhào piàn
en: He sent me three photos yesterday.
why: 了 attaches to 发 and comes before the counted object 三张照片. The time word 昨天 can come before or after the subject.

zh: 朋友们都到了。
py: péng you men dōu dào le
en: The friends have all arrived.
why: The friends were not here before and are now, so 了 ends the sentence. 都 must stay before the verb 到.

zh: 这个游戏太难了。
py: zhè ge yóu xì tài nán le
en: This game is too hard.
why: 太 + adjective as a complete remark ends in 了. 了 cannot come between 太 and 难.

zh: 我们快到朋友家了。
py: wǒ men kuài dào péng you jiā le
en: We're almost at my friend's place.
why: 快 … 了 frames something about to happen, so 了 closes the sentence after 朋友家. 快 must sit before the verb 到.

zh: 我昨天没回他的消息。
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi huí tā de xiāo xi
en: I didn't reply to his message yesterday.
why: 没 comes directly before the verb and the sentence takes no 了. 昨天 can go before or after the subject.

zh: 他已经看了三个小时的手机了。
py: tā yǐ jīng kàn le sān ge xiǎo shí de shǒu jī le
en: He has already been on his phone for three hours.
why: The amount so far takes 了 after the verb 看 and 了 at the end, with 已经 before the verb. 了 after 手机 alone would end the time as finished.

zh: 我现在不玩这个游戏了。
py: wǒ xiàn zài bù wán zhè ge yóu xì le
en: I don't play this game any more.
why: 不 goes before the verb and 了 ends the sentence for 'not any more'. 现在 can come before or after the subject.

zh: 你下了班就给我发消息。
py: nǐ xià le bān jiù gěi wǒ fā xiāo xi
en: Message me as soon as you get off work.
why: 了 follows the first verb 下, before 班, and 就 starts the follow-up. This is a future instruction and still uses 了.

zh: 上个周末我们在家打了一整天游戏。
py: shàng ge zhōu mò wǒ men zài jiā dǎ le yī zhěng tiān yóu xì
en: Last weekend we played games at home all day.
why: A finished stretch with a stated length: 了 right after 打, before 一整天. The time can come before or after 我们, but 在家 stays before the verb.

zh: 他每天晚上都在群里聊天。
py: tā měi tiān wǎn shang dōu zài qún lǐ liáo tiān
en: He chats in the group every night.
why: 每天晚上 makes this a habit, so the sentence has no 了 anywhere. 都 stays before the 在群里 phrase and the verb.

zh: 我们已经在群里聊了一个晚上了。
py: wǒ men yǐ jīng zài qún lǐ liáo le yī ge wǎn shang le
en: We've been chatting in the group all evening already.
why: 'So far, and still going' takes 了 after 聊 and again at the end. 已经 can sit before or after the 在群里 phrase, but both come before the verb.

zh: 这个软件的广告太多了。
py: zhè ge ruǎn jiàn de guǎng gào tài duō le
en: This app has too many ads.
why: A remark with 太 + adjective ends in 了. 太 sits before the adjective and 了 closes the sentence.

zh: 等我吃了饭再给你回电话。
py: děng wǒ chī le fàn zài gěi nǐ huí diàn huà
en: I'll call you back after I've eaten.
why: Even in a future plan, 了 follows 吃, before 饭, to mean 'once eating is done', and 再 starts the next step.

zh: 他昨天一整天都没看手机。
py: tā zuó tiān yī zhěng tiān dōu méi kàn shǒu jī
en: He didn't look at his phone at all yesterday.
why: 没 negates the verb directly and no 了 appears. The long time phrase can come before or after 他, but 都 stays directly before 没.

src: 她玩了三个小时的游戏。
src_py: tā wán le sān ge xiǎo shí de yóu xì
task: Add 已经 and say she is still playing.
zh: 她已经玩了三个小时的游戏了。
py: tā yǐ jīng wán le sān ge xiǎo shí de yóu xì le
en: She has already been playing for three hours.
why: For 'so far, and still going', add 已经 and a second 了 at the end. The first 了 after 玩 stays.

src_py: wǒ men zhōu mò qù pá shān
task: Say we changed our minds and are not going.
zh: 我们周末不去爬山了。
py: wǒ men zhōu mò bù qù pá shān le
en: We're not going hiking this weekend after all.
why: A changed plan is 不 + verb + 了 with 了 at the end. 没去 would only state that it did not happen.

src_py: wǒ gěi tā huí le xiāo xi
task: Make it negative: I didn't reply.
zh: 我没给他回消息。
py: wǒ méi gěi tā huí xiāo xi
en: I didn't reply to him.
why: Negating a completed action uses 没 before the verb phrase and drops 了. 不 + 了 would mean a changed decision.

src_py: zhè ge shǒu jī hěn guì
task: Say it's too expensive, as a remark.
zh: 这个手机太贵了。
py: zhè ge shǒu jī tài guì le
en: This phone is too expensive.
why: The 'too ...' remark replaces 很 with 太 and ends in 了. 很贵了 would not have this meaning.

src: 我先洗澡，然后给你打电话。
src_py: wǒ xiān xǐ zǎo ránhòu gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
task: Use 了 and 就: call as soon as you've showered.
zh: 我洗了澡就给你打电话。
py: wǒ xǐ le zǎo jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
en: I'll call you as soon as I've showered.
why: The 'once A is done, B' pattern puts 了 after the first verb, before its object, and links B with 就. 先 and 然后 drop out.

src_py: tā zuó tiān dǎ diàn huà
task: Say he made three calls yesterday.
zh: 他昨天打了三个电话。
py: tā zuó tiān dǎ le sān ge diàn huà
en: He made three calls yesterday.
why: A counted finished event: 了 attaches to 打 and the number comes after it. 昨天 can come before or after 他.

task: Say it has just run out of battery.
zh: 手机没电了。
py: shǒu jī méi diàn le
en: The phone has run out of battery.
why: A new situation that was not so before takes final 了.

src_py: tā děng le nǐ èr shí fēn zhōng
task: Say he has been waiting twenty minutes and is still waiting.
zh: 他已经等了你二十分钟了。
py: tā yǐ jīng děng le nǐ èr shí fēn zhōng le
en: He has already been waiting for you for twenty minutes.
why: The amount so far takes a second 了 at the end, and 已经 goes before the verb. One 了 only reports a finished wait.

src: 我昨天晚上在群里聊天了。
src_py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang zài qún lǐ liáo tiān le
task: Say you do this every night (a habit).
zh: 我每天晚上都在群里聊天。
py: wǒ měi tiān wǎn shang dōu zài qún lǐ liáo tiān
en: I chat in the group every night.
why: A habit takes no 了, so the final 了 of the one-time sentence is removed when 每天晚上都 is added.

src_py: tā mǎi le xīn shǒu jī
zh: 他没买新手机。
py: tā méi mǎi xīn shǒu jī
en: He didn't buy a new phone.
why: 没 denies the event, so 了 is removed. 不买了 would mean he gave up the idea.

s: 我刚才给你发了五条消息，你怎么不回？
s_py: wǒ gāng cái gěi nǐ fā le wǔ tiáo xiāo xi nǐ zěn me bù huí
zh: 我刚才给你发了五条消息，你怎么不回？
py: wǒ gāng cái gěi nǐ fā le wǔ tiáo xiāo xi nǐ zěn me bù huí
en: I just sent you five messages; why aren't you replying?
why: Correct: a finished act with a counted object takes 了 right after the verb. The later 不回 is a present question and needs no 了.

s: 手机充好电了，我们走吧。
s_py: shǒu jī chōng hǎo diàn le wǒ men zǒu ba
zh: 手机充好电了，我们走吧。
py: shǒu jī chōng hǎo diàn le wǒ men zǒu ba
en: The phone is charged now; let's go.
why: Correct: the phone is now charged and was not before, so 了 ends the clause. The result 好 does not replace 了.

s: 我昨天没看了那部电影。
s_py: wǒ zuó tiān méi kàn le nà bù diàn yǐng
zh: 我昨天没看那部电影。
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi kàn nà bù diàn yǐng
en: I didn't see that film yesterday.
why: 没 already negates the event, so 了 cannot follow the verb. 没看了 is never right for 'did not watch'.

s: 她昨天没有给我回了电话。
s_py: tā zuó tiān méi yǒu gěi wǒ huí le diàn huà
zh: 她昨天没有给我回电话。
py: tā zuó tiān méi yǒu gěi wǒ huí diàn huà
en: She didn't call me back yesterday.
why: 没有 negates the completed event, so 了 is deleted. 没有 … 了 after the verb does not occur.

s: 昨天晚上他在了朋友家。
s_py: zuó tiān wǎn shang tā zài le péng you jiā
zh: 昨天晚上他在朋友家。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shang tā zài péng you jiā
en: He was at a friend's place last night.
why: 在 meaning 'be at' is a state, so it takes no 了. 昨天晚上 already shows it is past.

s: 我当时觉得了那个游戏很无聊。
s_py: wǒ dāng shí jué de le nà ge yóu xì hěn wú liáo
zh: 我当时觉得那个游戏很无聊。
py: wǒ dāng shí jué de nà ge yóu xì hěn wú liáo
en: I thought that game was boring at the time.
why: 觉得 is an opinion, not a completed act, so no 了 follows it. 当时 gives the past.

s: 我知道了，谢谢你告诉我。
s_py: wǒ zhī dào le xiè xie nǐ gào sù wǒ
zh: 我知道了，谢谢你告诉我。
py: wǒ zhī dào le xiè xie nǐ gào sù wǒ
en: Got it, thanks for telling me.
why: Correct: 知道 usually takes no 了 for a plain state, but here 了 marks a change from not knowing to knowing. That is the sentence-final change 了.

s: 小时候我常常和朋友们一起玩了游戏。
s_py: xiǎo shí hou wǒ cháng cháng hé péng you men yī qǐ wán le yóu xì
zh: 小时候我常常和朋友们一起玩游戏。
py: xiǎo shí hou wǒ cháng cháng hé péng you men yī qǐ wán yóu xì
en: When I was little I often played games with my friends.
why: 常常 marks a repeated habit, so no 了 on the verb, even though it happened in the past.

s: 上大学的时候，我们每个星期六都去朋友家吃饭。
s_py: shàng dà xué de shí hou wǒ men měi ge xīng qī liù dōu qù péng you jiā chī fàn
zh: 上大学的时候，我们每个星期六都去朋友家吃饭。
py: shàng dà xué de shí hou wǒ men měi ge xīng qī liù dōu qù péng you jiā chī fàn
en: When we were at university, we went to a friend's place for dinner every Saturday.
why: Correct despite the past time: 每个星期六都 makes it a repeated habit, so there is no 了.

s: 我太喜欢了这个游戏。
s_py: wǒ tài xǐ huan le zhè ge yóu xì
zh: 我太喜欢这个游戏了。
py: wǒ tài xǐ huan zhè ge yóu xì le
en: I like this game so much.
why: In a 太 remark, 了 closes the whole remark after the object, not right after the verb 喜欢.

s: 这个手机不太贵，我想买。
s_py: zhè ge shǒu jī bù tài guì wǒ xiǎng mǎi
zh: 这个手机不太贵，我想买。
py: zhè ge shǒu jī bù tài guì wǒ xiǎng mǎi
en: This phone isn't very expensive; I want to buy it.
why: Correct: 不太 + adjective means 'not very' and takes no 了. Only the 'too ...' remark with 太 ends in 了.

s: 我不喝了奶茶。
s_py: wǒ bù hē le nǎi chá
zh: 我不喝奶茶了。
py: wǒ bù hē nǎi chá le
en: I don't drink bubble tea any more.
why: For 'not any more', 了 goes at the end of the sentence, not after the verb.

s: 我没有流量了，你能开一下热点吗？
s_py: wǒ méi yǒu liú liàng le nǐ néng kāi yī xià rè diǎn ma
zh: 我没有流量了，你能开一下热点吗？
py: wǒ méi yǒu liú liàng le nǐ néng kāi yī xià rè diǎn ma
en: I've run out of data; can you turn on your hotspot?
why: Correct: 没有 + noun + 了 means 'none left'. This is one of the legitimate places where 没 and 了 meet.

s: 他们已经打游戏了一个晚上了。
s_py: tā men yǐ jīng dǎ yóu xì le yī ge wǎn shang le
zh: 他们已经打了一个晚上游戏了。
py: tā men yǐ jīng dǎ le yī ge wǎn shang yóu xì le
en: They've been playing games all evening already.
why: With a duration, the first 了 goes right after the verb 打, before 一个晚上, not after the object 游戏.

s: 我已经玩了一个下午游戏了，该写作业了。
s_py: wǒ yǐ jīng wán le yī ge xià wǔ yóu xì le gāi xiě zuò yè le
zh: 我已经玩了一个下午游戏了，该写作业了。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng wán le yī ge xià wǔ yóu xì le gāi xiě zuò yè le
en: I've been playing games all afternoon; time to do my homework.
why: Correct: two 了 mark the amount so far. The first follows 玩 and the last 了 says it is now time to stop.

s: 你下了地铁就给我打电话吧。
s_py: nǐ xià le dì tiě jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà ba
zh: 你下了地铁就给我打电话吧。
py: nǐ xià le dì tiě jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà ba
en: Call me as soon as you get off the subway.
why: Correct: although it is about the future, 了 follows the first verb 下 in the 'once A is done, B' pattern.

s: 他们下个月就要了结婚。
s_py: tā men xià ge yuè jiù yào le jié hūn
zh: 他们下个月就要结婚了。
py: tā men xià ge yuè jiù yào jié hūn le
en: They're getting married next month.
why: In 就要 … 了, the 了 closes the sentence after the verb phrase and cannot sit between 要 and the verb.

s: 我每天晚上给朋友打了电话。
s_py: wǒ měi tiān wǎn shang gěi péng you dǎ le diàn huà
zh: 我每天晚上给朋友打电话。
py: wǒ měi tiān wǎn shang gěi péng you dǎ diàn huà
en: I phone a friend every night.
why: 每天晚上 makes this a routine, so the verb takes no 了. 打了电话 would be one finished call.

s: 我已经三天没看手机了，感觉特别轻松。
s_py: wǒ yǐ jīng sān tiān méi kàn shǒu jī le gǎn jué tè bié qīng sōng
zh: 我已经三天没看手机了，感觉特别轻松。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng sān tiān méi kàn shǒu jī le gǎn jué tè bié qīng sōng
en: I haven't looked at my phone for three days and I feel so relaxed.
why: Correct: time + 没 + verb + 了 is a legitimate pattern for 'for N days now, not'. It is not a negated completed action.

s: 那时候我们都很喜欢了这个软件，天天用。
s_py: nà shí hou wǒ men dōu hěn xǐ huan le zhè ge ruǎn jiàn tiān tiān yòng
zh: 那时候我们都很喜欢这个软件，天天用。
py: nà shí hou wǒ men dōu hěn xǐ huan zhè ge ruǎn jiàn tiān tiān yòng
en: At that time we all liked this app a lot and used it every day.
why: 喜欢 is a feeling and takes no 了 after the verb, even in a past description.
